summary: Root decided (FS-GG/.github#4818, 2026-10-24) that the held hosted original-operation DOM route adds ceremony without distinct evidence once ADR-0096 ordinary local verification qualifies the 27 typed DOM cases (nine each in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, 27/27 on the merged Templates#784 tree). Removed: .github/workflows/current-reference-composition.yml (manual dispatch, ADMISSION=None, literal-false receiver), current-composition-managed.py and its controls, and the hosted admission constant; the only entry to verify-external-reference-candidate.sh in current mode is the local runner gate. Kept: the typed current-composition-plan, current-composition-observations.py, the source stage and current-composition-local.py. Residue deliberately left: a `composition` naming contract in the shared retained reader retained-reference-rehearsal.py (and its digest joins with the D5/earlier-three lanes) is now unreachable; removing it needs those lanes' coordination. If hosted CI coverage is wanted later, an optional job may run the same local runner; that would be new source, not a revival. Historical report 2026-10-23-held-current-reference-dom.md is kept with a retirement note. The older Atlas record on the held adapter describes the PR767 window and is retained.
title: The held hosted original-operation DOM route is retired in favor of the local ADR-0096 runner
